title: Flowerfall+ Server Modpack
description: Flowerfall+ creates an enjoyable immersive experience for the player using a variety of client-side modifications that optimizes your game, improves visuals, and adds a bit of spice to everything!
body:
Flowerfall+ creates an enjoyable immersive experience for the player using a variety of client-side modifications that optimizes your game, improves visuals, and adds a bit of spice to everything!

 

Summarized Features

- Holstered weapons

- Custom discord status display when in-game

- Optimizations with Sodium, Lithium, and Phosphor

- Xaero's Mini-Map

- RPG-Hud

- Custom animations
- Iris Shaders

- And many more to come!
